diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says OUT, datasheet reading says black OUT
diffs.evidence: Same pin, only naming differs: the second reading prefixed the wire colour, while the model names the pin OUT and its description already says it is the black wire; the vendor listing for this LJC18A3-H-Z sensor family gives the lead colours as 'Brown: Feed (+) Plus  Blue: Feed (-) Minus  Black: Exit', so pin 2 (black) is the output in both readings.
